question: Can a conventional causal Transformer be instantiated within one percent of the successful four-layer one-million-parameter LANGCACHE104 model and support correct parallel training attention plus incremental KV-cached inference?

transformer_control.attention: dense causal training attention and bounded 128-position inference KV cache
transformer_control.embedding: fixed 256 bytes with tied output weights

proposed_training_if_gates_are_later_sat.dataset: the exact frozen LANGDEPTH106 Tiny Shakespeare source and 90/5/5 split
proposed_training_if_gates_are_later_sat.optimizer: AdamW with the unchanged LANGDEPTH106 schedule
proposed_training_if_gates_are_later_sat.selection: fixed final checkpoint only; no per-arm tuning

interpretation_limits: No model is trained or scored by this registration.
The former LANGDEPTH106 TEST has already been opened and is not a newly sealed comparison set.
Equal parameter count and data exposure do not establish equal training FLOPs.
Tiny Shakespeare cannot establish general language, exact recall, reasoning or commercial capability.
The Transformer is a competent small control, not a reproduction of a frontier pretrained model.
